title: Native history objects shown
description: What cst show --json prints in a native repository (CLI output; native/cli/src/native_log.rs, ADR-0047 decision 12): each object named, in order, an annotated tag followed by what it tags, as git show prints them; a commit already shown is not repeated. A commit entry is causet.log/v1's commit with type commit; a tag entry is a native tag (docs/native-history/commits.md §4). Text members follow causet.log/v1's rules.

object.description: A commit, with causet.log/v1's commit members, or a tag, with the members below.

name.description: A tag's name, empty for one Git wrote with none.

nameHex.description: A tag's name as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.

target.description: What a tag tags, by the ID a command names it by.

targetType.description: The Git type of what a tag tags.

message.description: The message, a tag's inline signature included.

messageHex.description: The message as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.
